items.evidence: apiLevel 2.15; all volumes (5, 4, 1 µL) are handled by the P20 within its range, the 10 µL wells are far below capacity, and the right labware is used.

One tip is reused only for master mix into empty wells. Fresh tips are used for every primer and every colony transfer, and every tip is dropped. The tip_before_aspirate, tip_dropped_at_end and no_cross_contamination checks passed.

The agent follows the paper's OT-2 order (mix first, then 1 µL colony) for a 10 µL reaction. It assembles the 9 µL mix in the well as 5 µL Q5 plus 4 µL primers and states this adaptation and its primer-concentration assumption in comments. The thermocycling comment is a Q5-adapted program.
Each well gets 5 µL Q5 2x (1x final), 4 µL of its own primer pair and 1 µL colony template added last, giving a 10 µL reaction.
zip(primers, dests) and zip(colonies, dests) over wells() map A1 to A1 and so on across all 96 wells, each used once.
A comment records sealing the plate, then 98 C for 3 min, 30 cycles of 98 C/60 C/72 C, 72 C for 2 min, and a 4 C hold, which suits Q5.

judge.summary: The protocol sets up 96 ten-µL colony PCRs with correct mapping, sensible tip handling and a Q5-appropriate thermocycling comment. The only failed check was the pcr_plate end state, which expects 20 µL per well. The rubric accepts a 10 µL reaction, so I did not penalise it.
